title: Irontech S44 ROS MAX
answer: Irontech identifies S44 ROS MAX as the head on its Molly Natural listing with the 166cm 2.0 body. This documents that specific factory-listed configuration, not a general replacement-head fit list.
detail: Keep S44, ROS MAX and 166cm 2.0 together in the written build specification. The face code, head construction and body identity answer different questions; a similar-looking S44 photograph does not establish the same version or pairing.
boundary: Do not transfer this pairing to another body, head revision or connector by assumption. A factory-listed configuration is not a certificate that every separately sold head with the same face code is interchangeable.
sourceTitle: Irontech: 166cm 2.0 S44 ROS MAX Molly Natural

title: Irontech S19
answer: Irontech names the S19 head with the 164LN body on its Pearl Natural listing. That written factory example identifies one pairing; it does not establish a ROS or ROS MAX revision for every S19 head.
detail: Use the complete 164LN body identity when comparing this example. The same head code or Pearl name on a different product is not enough to establish the same body, head mechanism or included configuration.
boundary: Do not fill in a construction label or connector specification from another product's menu. Measurements and weight belong to the exact body and configuration, not to the S19 face code alone.

title: Irontech S40
answer: Irontech's Eileen Natural description explicitly pairs the 164LN body with the S40 head sculpt. This reference covers that named edition, not every Eileen listing or every S40 head version.
detail: Read the body code and head code together: 164LN and S40. A familiar model name or face is not enough to merge different body references, copy dimensions or identify a head's internal construction.
boundary: Do not borrow measurements, mechanism labels or replacement-head compatibility from a different Eileen edition or a shared options menu. Compare the exact written configuration rather than the name alone.
